purpose: Make the production SaaS spine visible without turning Heavyster into a technical dashboard.
phase: Active prototype moving toward production SaaS
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment collection, no rental commission, and supplier keeps rental payment direct while Heavyster earns listing SaaS revenue.

pricing.phase_two_optional_success_fee: 1% only after confirmed quote, award, enquiry, or booking workflow proof

records.name: SupplierAccount
records.job: Own the rental company profile, contacts, service regions, plan, and account status.
records.ui_rule: Show company readiness, not database structure.

records.name: EquipmentListing
records.job: Publish each machine with category, make, model, region, availability, proof, paid status, and visibility.
records.ui_rule: A supplier should be able to list one machine without learning the whole product.

records.name: ProofDocument
records.job: Track photos, licenses, insurance, inspections, operator certificates, expiry, and review state.
records.ui_rule: Proof appears as confidence, not paperwork.

records.name: ListingSubscription
records.job: Track billable listing count, monthly or annual plan, renewal state, invoice status, and cancellation.
records.ui_rule: Pricing stays one clean rule: paid active listings.

records.name: DirectEnquiry
records.job: Log buyer message, supplier route, response state, copied packet, and direct-payment reminder.
records.ui_rule: Lead value is visible while rental payment stays outside Heavyster.

records.name: AdminReview
records.job: Approve suppliers, approve listings, flag proof gaps, hide risky inventory, and add support notes.
records.ui_rule: Founder control stays simple: approve, fix, hide, or follow up.

acceptance: One supplier account can be created.
One equipment listing can be created and marked paid or draft.
One proof document can be attached to a listing.
One direct enquiry can be logged and routed to the supplier.
One admin review can approve or hide a supplier/listing.
No rental payment record exists in phase one.
simplicity_rules: Show one next action per role.
Keep backend states inside calm cards.
Protect USD listing SaaS before adding commission rails.
Do not add AI unless it shortens the next action.
